cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't announce where the office biscuits are yet. I haven't finished checking the delivery record.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Reception has the box. I'm going down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A box is not an identification. Bring it here unopened and I'll establish the contents.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've opened it. They're eating them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ask which biscuits. Precisely. Nobody calls this solved before I've checked it against the order.

reason: Preserve the trivial delivery contest but replace labels with actual moving verification criteria, so every advance by others forces A to reclaim control of the solution.
